name: Runner Extras - FlowField Filter Visitor
brief: Regression: SetRange on a FlowField (count) is evaluated via the temp-table filter visitor without an NRE on a self-referencing/empty CalcFormula.
description: Reproduces the Purch.-Post posting-path gap where SetRange("<FlowField>", 0) forced TempTableDataProvider's RecordBufferEvaluatorVisitor to call FlowFieldsHelper.CalcFieldsAsync directly. Before the fix, FieldsAndFormulaAreSelfReferencing NRE'd on a null Filters collection (EmptyFormula), and resolving the source table by name was missing. This suite proves the filter visitor computes the FlowField count faithfully (0 when no children, N when N children) and that filtering on it returns the correct rows.
